note: Folders the application watches for HTC Global's own weekly intelligence. The nightly round reads everything new in them without anyone clicking; the Import page reads the same folders for anything held back. Each folder lists the places it may be, and the first one that exists is used: the same application runs from a Windows desktop and from a mounted copy, and the tree above the project is not the same in both. ${HOME} is the user's home folder and ${PROJECT} is the folder the application runs from. When none of the places exist the page says so rather than showing an empty list. `rights_class` is what the documents in that folder may be used for, stated once by Stefan for a family that produces the same thing every week - the engine refuses an import without one, and a folder that states none has its prices left for the Import page rather than guessed at. Adding a report is an entry here, not a release.
